🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
No match to any known recurring incident — two separate things are reported, and both hinge on state we can only read per-conversion, not from config.

What we checked

  • Converting an investigation to a case is built to mark that investigation as "in a case", and the investigations list is built to exclude anything in that state — so an investigation vanishing from your list after conversion is the designed behaviour, not deletion; its contents are still held against the investigation.

  • The search results are not written into the case by the conversion itself — a separate background step renders them and pushes them across afterwards, records a per-investigation outcome (in progress / done / failed), and has a built-in retry; the investigation is marked converted immediately, before that step reports back.

Next

  • Look up the two investigations and read back their stored case reference plus the recorded outcome of the content transfer — that gives the case number for "Ryan Yakow" and says whether anything was ever sent.

  • If the transfer is anything other than "done", use the built-in retry for those investigations; if it is "done", open the case by its case number rather than searching by title.

Hi @Paul Marderosian, sorry for taking so long, this investigation was a little crazy.


Checked: Attempted to replicate the reported issue directly; could not reproduce it.

Found: The PDF that compiles investigation evidence renders empty, showing only (#) in the top-left corner. Confirmed on both cases, Rayshawn Nichols 2026-150020-1 and Ryan Yakow 2026-150020-2. This matches the known issue already tracked in reopened ticket https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6676.

Also noted: The Yakow case does exist in Incident, but its subject name field shows only ",". Possibly a data-entry error; not confirmed.

Next: Share the Yakow case number with the client and point them to where the evidence sits in Secure as a temporary workaround while ENG-6676 is resolved.

Hello @mike_croze@vfc.com,

Update on your two cases: the Ryan Yakow investigation was created successfully, and the case number is 2026-150020-2. Please verify whether you can access it through this link: https://apps.lpguys.net/vfcorp/nettrack/LPMS/lpmseditmenu.aspx?MasterCaseID=461&ShopliftingID=461&SuspectID=461&StoreIdent=1060

For both this case and the Rayshawn Nichols case (2026-150020-1), the automatically compiled evidence PDF is not displaying correctly, which is why the search results appear missing.

As a temporary workaround, you can access the evidence directly in Secure, or export it yourself as a PDF:

  1. Open the Investigations list and select the Completed tab (top right).

  2. Open the investigation you need.

  3. Click Share on the top bar, then Export to PDF.

We are continuing to work on the compiled PDF issue and will follow up once it is resolved.
